title: DynIsf Factor reset to 100% during 3.3.0.0 Update
symptom: After update to version 3.3.0.0 from 3.2.0.4 the DynISF factor is reset to 100%. The same happens when restoring a profile created with the old AAPS version.
cause: Missing migration code to transfer the DynISF factor setting from DynISF plugin to the OpenAPS SMB plugin.
